name: io.github.inmoprice/clipcliper
title: CLIPCLIPER
description: Turn a public video link (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, TikTok) into a timestamped transcript, chapters and clip suggestions. Hosted; free tier without a key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <CLIPCLIPER license key>. Optional: without it, up to 3 videos per day of up to 15 minutes per IP.

environmentVariables.name: CLIPCLIPER_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: License key from any CLIPCLIPER hour pack. Optional: without it the free tier applies.
